headline: Nigeria Initiates $37 Household Cash Transfers Under NERSI Welfare Program
summary: Nigeria launched a federal cash relief initiative paying approximately $37 per household under the newly announced National Economic Recovery and Social Intervention scheme.
why: Social safety nets in developing markets help cushion consumer spending against high inflation while reflecting government fiscal expenditure priorities.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: The federal government commenced direct cash relief distributions of roughly $37 per household.
